name: Project Canvas
description: Authoring guidance for Project Canvas boards
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.tagline: An infinite board whose cards are live editors on your real files
marketplace.longDescription: Project Canvas is an infinite board where a card is not a screenshot of a file but the file's actual editor, mounted live. A mockup card renders the mockup, a spreadsheet card renders the grid, a markdown card renders the document. Arrange screens, plans, data, and notes spatially and wire them with edges. The editor ships inside Nimbalyst; this extension adds the authoring guidance an AI session needs to build a board for you from a description.
highlights: Cards mount the real editor for the file they point at, not a preview
Ask an agent for a board and get one laid out on the grid, wired with edges
JSON Canvas 1.0 on disk, so a board written by another tool round-trips

screenshots.alt: Project Canvas board with live markdown, mockup, mindmap, and spreadsheet cards wired together inside a frame
